Daily Devotional

November 8

24 Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed. (1 Peter 2:24 KJV)

This verse is confirming the prophecy of Isaiah (Isaiah 53:5), and it puts the healing by Jesus stripes in the past tense showing that it was already done. So the atonement of Jesus, not only paid for our sins, but also gave us healing of our bodies. Some have tried to say that this healing meant only our spiritual healing, but in Matthew (Matthew 8:17) it quotes this scripture from Isaiah, and clarifies that it is talking about healing our sicknesses. Our Savior Jesus, in His death, provided for our forgiveness of sins, prosperity, deliverance and healing, so we can take advantage of all these things now, in this life (John 10:10). One of the signs of the end times is that the power will be gone from the teaching of God’s Word, and that is so true today.

Why do most churches try to say that Jesus only died for our sins, and thereby kept us from going to hell, but don’t want to include the rest of His atonement? It can only be because the church does not want to have to demonstrate the power of God in our daily lives. If the pastors would just teach the true Gospel, and quit minimizing it, then all Christians could walk in the prosperity, deliverance and good health that our Father wants us to have. The Saints then could do the work that Jesus did, and commanded us to do (John 14:12). The Spiritual Gifts (1 Corinthians 12:8-10) of the bible did not pass away with the Apostles as some teach, but are for us today. Read God’s Word and you will discover the truth about the Good News of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. If you will just believe the Word of God as it is written, then you will know the truth, and it will set you free (John 8:32). You must not leave out, or add too, the Word of God as it is written, as it is truth (Revelation 22:18-19). Thank you Lord for your Word!
